description.text: Classes The Course Program Advanced Classes Advanced Intensive Reading, Advanced Listening Comprehension, Advanced Oral Chinese, Advanced Reading, Advanced Chinese Composition, Selected Reading of Chinese Newspapers and Magazines, Tutorial Classes for HSK, Lectures on Chinese Culture and History, Chinese Singing and Dancing, Chinese Calligraphy, Taijiquan, Taijijian Intermediate Classes Intermediate Intensive Reading, Intermediate Listening and Speaking, Intermediate Chinese Reading, Intermediate Chinese Composition, Basic Reading of Chinese Newspapers and Magazines, Tutorial Classes for HSK, Chinese Singing and Dancing, Chinese Calligraphy, Taijiquan, Taijijian Preliminary Classes Preliminary Intensive Reading, Preliminary Oral Chinese, Preliminary Chinese Reading, Preliminary Chinese Listening Comprehension, Tutorial Classes for HSK, Chinese Singing and Dancing, Chinese Calligraphy, Taijiquan, Taijijian Tuition fee: 15,000/School year 7,500/Semester

duration.text: The Long-Term Chinese Language Training Program at Hebei University is a 1 Year long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2222 USD/per year ￥ 16000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Certificate/Diploma of highest education The certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 4. Graduation Certificate of High school Graduation Certificate should be in English or Chinese, if not，it should be translated into English or Chinese and be notarized 5. Health Certificate Photocopy of physical examination record. 6. Letter of guarantee The guardian should write out his/her name, nationality, occupation and address (if an organization acts as the guardian, reference to the organization should be made clear). You can download a template or sample from Here.doc.

requirements.text: 1.Applicant should hold high school graduation or equivalent to a Chinese high school graduate
